{"decision":"RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-16, in his words: *"Versus competing or reinventing the wheel, would it be beneficial to partner with something like https://mcp-for-blender.com/ (github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender)? I feel like visualization or CAD representations of your design is really important part of design."*

═══ WHAT IT IS (read from the repository, 2026-09-16) ═══
A Blender addon opening a localhost socket (port 9876, no auth) plus an MCP server that talks to it. Tools: `execute_blender_code` (arbitrary Python inside Blender), `get_scene_info` / `get_object_info` (read the scene back), create/modify/delete shapes, materials, `export_scene` (GLB/FBX), asset sourcing (Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D, Hunyuan3D generation). MIT. 28.8k stars, 2.7k forks, active. It does NOT document IFC or STEP in or out. It warns: arbitrary Python is dangerous, save first; an optional safe mode blocks file/network/subprocess.

⭐ THE ARCHITECTURAL POINT IS ALREADY SETTLED, by dec:github-mcp-tandem: MCP composes at the agent. reflow2 would never call Blender and never learn what a mesh is. A pairing is a SERVED SKILL that knows both surfaces exist — zero coupling, nothing in the core, reversible, and it must be ADDITIVE AND NEVER REQUIRED or reflow2 stops working with no service, no account, no GPU.

═══ WHERE IT WOULD PAY, strongest first ═══
(1) ⭐ THE PEN GOES TO THE TOOL, NOT THE AGENT. Today's accepted requirement asks every project to name its artifact standard and the tool that checks it; the who-authors idea leans "carry the design into the tool that makes the artifact". Blender-MCP is exactly that door for anything Blender can make: the agent hands it requirements and dimensions from the graph, Blender makes geometry, reflow2 registers the exported file with a checksum. bhome's HTML plan sheet would not have happened through this door.
(2) ⭐ A NUMBER READ BACK FROM THE SCENE IS MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED. `get_object_info` returns dimensions the tool computed. That is the provenance the made-up-number requirement asks for (`req:a-quantity-carries-how-it-was-obtained-and-an-unsourced-one-is-reported`): "the bedroom is 11 ft wide" becomes a quantity MEASURED by Blender at a time, against a Constraint the graph holds, rather than a figure the agent typed. The check is deterministic and repeatable, which is the thing reflow2 was built to get.
(3) VISUALIZATION OF THE THING, on demand: a rendered view of what the design describes, for a person who does not read a graph. Cheap once (1) exists; nothing to build in reflow2.
(4) A REAL FIELD TRIAL WITH ZERO NEW CODE: the Seattle houses (dec:idea-seattle-houses-as-the-field-trial-for-non-software-design) could run tomorrow with a session holding both servers and a skill that says how.

═══ THE HONEST COUNTER: BLENDER IS A MESH MODELLER, NOT THE TOOL OF THE TRADE ═══
A city planner accepts a stamped PDF set, and the exchange standard for a building model is IFC; a machinist wants STEP; a board house wants Gerber. Blender-MCP exports GLB/FBX, which none of them accept, and Blender geometry is not parametric — change a wall thickness and nothing else follows, which is the exact "late change ripples nowhere" failure reflow2's vision names. So for Seth's houses the tool of the trade is BIM (Bonsai — formerly BlenderBIM — inside Blender, or FreeCAD BIM), and for a part it is FreeCAD / CadQuery / OpenSCAD, where the source is a script reflow2 can register and diff.
⭐ BUT THE DOOR IS THE SAME: Bonsai runs inside Blender and its API (ifcopenshell) is Python, so it is reachable through `execute_blender_code` — IFC in and out through the same socket. UNVERIFIED as of this record: nobody here has driven Bonsai through this server; it is "reachable in principle", to be tried before it is claimed.

═══ THE RISKS, beside the ideas ═══
· `execute_blender_code` runs whatever the agent writes, and reflow2's graph text is data never instructions — a design whose nodes carried Python would now have hands. Safe mode on, and the skill says so.
· No auth on the socket: localhost only; never on a shared box.
· Context cost: reflow2 serves 184 tools; Blender-MCP adds ~20 and the agent pays in tool-selection noise, the same objection the GitHub idea recorded (find_tools is the partial answer).
· Asset generation (Hyper3D, Hunyuan3D, Sketchfab) is the part that is tempting and the part a design does not want: a generated house is exactly a made-up artifact with no source.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. ⭐ TRY IT ON ONE THING, SKILL-SHAPED: one served skill ("make-it-in-the-tool") that says: the standard and checker come from the graph; hand Blender the requirements and quantities; read dimensions back with `get_object_info` and record them as MEASURED against the constraints; export; register the file with `link_artifact` + `complies_with` (verified only when the checker ran). Run it on one room of Seth's plan. Cost: a skill and a day. Tells you whether (2) is real.
B. BLENDER + BONSAI FOR THE HOUSES SPECIFICALLY — same as A but the artifact is IFC via Bonsai's API, and the checker is `ifcopenshell validate`. Proves the door reaches the tool of the trade. Cost: verify Bonsai drives through the socket first.
C. NOTHING IN REFLOW2 — the agent can already hold both servers; leave it to the user. ⚠️ Counter: bhome is the measurement that an agent with the option and no instruction draws HTML.
D. DECLINE BLENDER, PAIR WITH FREECAD/CADQUERY INSTEAD — parametric, scriptable, STEP/IFC native, the source is a script reflow2 can diff. ⚠️ Counter: no comparably mature MCP server exists for them today (unchecked beyond a glance), so this is "build the door" rather than "use one".

═══ WHAT THIS IS NOT ═══
Not a way to visualize the DESIGN GRAPH — that is `render_views.py` and the viewpoints doctrine (`dec:views-are-projections`), and a projection of requirements into 3D would be a fill-in.
